# T-1: Define review failure taxonomy

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add a single review failure classification model that represents review verdict failure, subprocess failure, provider failure, input size failure, and maxAttempts exceeded with recovery metadata.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 classifications are represented in one reusable module or class family.
- Provider failure reasons include rate limit, quota, and API error without creating separate top-level classifications.
- The model exposes whether reviewRetry is consumed and what recovery hint or command applies.
- The model can serialize to flow.json reviewStop and to failure envelope data.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer a dedicated class-based representation if the value carries invariant or behavior. Keep src/ generic and avoid project-specific text.

## Test Strategy
Unit test the classifier and recovery metadata for each classification.
